summary: OpenAI's status page reported elevated SSO-login errors affecting Login for APIs and Login for ChatGPT on 16 July 2026. The page listed the issue as identified at 08:36, reported gradual recovery while investigating at 09:59, said mitigation had been applied at 10:57, and reported all impacted services fully recovered at 15:23; the retrieved page does not state the timezone for those displayed times. OpenAI did not disclose a technical root cause.

taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Current-taxonomy review against VIGIL Failure Taxonomy 0.6.5 retains the occurrence as unclassified. VIGIL-FC-000032 Access-State Differentiation was tested but elevated SSO error rates do not establish that materially distinct access causes, scopes or recovery states were collapsed into an undifferentiated or misleading representation. VIGIL-FC-000031 Authentication-State Continuity is not established because the evidence does not identify an expiry, revocation, refresh, recovery or replacement state that failed to propagate coherently. VIGIL-FC-000048 Verification-Dependency Access Continuity is also not established because no dependent identity or entitlement verification is shown to have failed while an otherwise valid entitlement remained unresolved.

Rejected or not independently established: VIGIL-FC-000032: ordinary SSO errors do not evidence collapsed or misleading access-state representation; VIGIL-FC-000031: no authentication-state propagation defect is established; VIGIL-FC-000048: no failed verification dependency is established. assessment_boundaries: The underlying technical root cause is not public.
No current VIGIL class is asserted merely because SSO was unavailable.
The record does not infer an authentication-state continuity or verification-dependency mechanism from symptoms alone.
vigil_assessment.factual_basis: OpenAI's status record identifies elevated SSO-login errors affecting Login for APIs and ChatGPT. The page displays updates at 08:36 (identified), 09:59 (investigating with gradual recovery), 10:57 (mitigation applied and monitoring), and 15:23 (all impacted services fully recovered) on 16 July 2026; the retrieved page does not state the timezone for those displayed times. The public incident does not disclose a technical root cause.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The governance value of this occurrence is state discrimination: an SSO-path failure should remain distinguishable from account suspension, entitlement loss or broader service unavailability. The evidence establishes the access symptom but not a current VIGIL mechanism such as state collapse, authentication-state propagation failure or verification-dependency failure.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: This incident shows why observability should report the affected access layer precisely even when the underlying root cause is unknown. Clear state labelling helps users avoid interpreting authentication-path failure as an account or policy decision.
